pipeline.label: Project progress
pipeline.confirm: Answer first: how far is the system?

nextActions.confirmDelivery: Say how far the system is

nextActionHints.continueInterview: A few answers are still missing before the project can be structured.
nextActionHints.resolveBlocker: A task is blocked. Unblock it before starting new work.
nextActionHints.resolveConflicts: Some answers contradict each other. Decide which one is right.
nextActionHints.resolveOpenQuestions: Some requirements are still unknown. Answer them or keep them open on purpose.
nextActionHints.reviewPrd: Read the generated PRD, edit what is off and approve it.
nextActionHints.reviewPlan: The plan has no tasks yet. Add the first ones.
nextActionHints.startFirstTask: The plan is approved. Move the first task to in progress.
nextActionHints.restoreProject: This project is archived. Restore it to keep working.
nextActionHints.reviewProposal: Saqina or an agent prepared changes that wait for your approval. Nothing is applied until you approve.
nextActionHints.inspectAgentFailure: An agent run failed. See why, then retry, reassign or cancel it.
nextActionHints.confirmDelivery: This project came from GitHub and may already be built, in review or live. Answer three questions so the stages match.
nextActionHints.systemLive: Build, review and deploy are done. Keep it up to date through maintenance and changes.
nextActionHints.deploySystem: It is built and reviewed. Deploy it, then say so on Progress.

platform.title: Where will people use it, and how do they sign in?

constraints.hint: Deadlines, budget, regulations, existing tools. Optional.
constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.placeholder: Must launch before Ramadan. Staff use shared Android tablets.

interview.completedImported: This project was imported from GitHub, so it was set up from what the repository says and no interview was needed. Requirements, PRD, plan and tasks are ready. The answers were read from the repository and are marked as imported until you confirm them.

ai.title: Review with AI
ai.body: The AI model set up by the platform owner checks these answers and your imported documents, flags what looks doubtful or missing, and suggests values. You decide what to apply.
ai.privacy: This sends your answers and imported documents to that model.

reasons.no_model: No AI model is chosen yet. The platform owner can pick a default model under AI & Models → Models.
reasons.capability_missing: “{model}” is not marked as able to return structured answers (missing: {missing}). The platform owner can enable it for this model under AI & Models → Models.
reasons.model_unavailable: “{model}” cannot be used right now: the model or its provider is disabled, or the provider connection failed its test. Check AI & Models.
reasons.provider_failed: “{model}” did not answer ({code}). Check the provider key and the model id under AI & Models.

review.title: Here is what we understood
review.conflictsHint: Choose what is correct. Nothing is decided for you.
review.openHint: Answer now, or keep it open; it stays visible as an open question.
review.recommendationHint: Every recommendation is editable. Your changes are marked as yours.
review.landingWhyNot: Other concepts were not chosen because they fit different goals; you can still pick another one later.
review.resolveFirst: Resolve the conflicts above before creating the project.
review.readyBody: We've created your initial project context:

mcpServer.title: Agent access (MCP)
mcpServer.intro: External agents such as Claude Code and Cursor can read this project's PRD, PLAN and custom documents live, and propose changes. Every proposed change appears as a diff that a project member must approve, and business documents are never exposed.
mcpServer.snippetHint: Replace YOUR_TOKEN with a token created below.
mcpServer.label: Label
mcpServer.oneTimeWarning: This token is shown only once. Copy it now and store it somewhere safe. You cannot view it again.
mcpServer.empty: No tokens yet. Create one to connect an agent.
mcpServer.revokeBody: Any agent using this token loses access immediately. This cannot be undone.
